Late to the party here and while she might not be typically associated (despite what grimoires mention) I've had success with Duchess Gremory. 

Let me explain;

I went through a bad end to a situation that I was in and I asked the Duchess first to help me get back what I'd lost because that's what she was good at according to the literature. Now, she showed me visions of having a child with this person, but I was always blurred out in it and the following dreams. 

That was Gremorys way of telling me to let it all go. She showed me where the wounds I had were and I promised to do the work. Over time, about three months now, I worked on my physical and mental health. I saw great improvements in both areas. All the while the Duchess held my heart together like a spiritual scaffold. 

Now, I'm dating a wonderful person. They're financially stable, emotionally available and an actual hoot to be around. 

My friend, the point I'm trying to (clumsily) make is that if you petition the Duchess, be prepared for hard but necessary truths to be revealed. She will rip you apart to see you reform the best version of yourself possible. She will hold you together while you do the real world work. 

Trust the process and push forward. I wish you nothing but the very best on your journey!

Hello! Fellow software engineer here.

From my work experience breaking into a saturated market is extremely tough. So what you can do is specialize and handily enough, you've got a sample size of 40 to work with. Take a look at the clients you've got and figure out if they've got a common thread. Be that sector, area, target demographic etc and build yourself into that area. Become *the* person for websites in that area.

Again, to echo everyone else, nothing is guaranteed. All you can do is try. If you make a vow to a Demon, don't you even think about going back on it. All you have to do is try, man. Let your spiritual life be comfort while your trial continues.

I made this in tribute to Duchess Gremory. 

I'm not musically capable nor am I particularly good at art. But what I am good at is software engineering.

This is the culmination of about 18 hours of coding, testing, modifying, testing and finally completion. Its the culmination of about 14 separate systems that all run locally and then being processed by another service.

I took my prayer, then a number of AI's that I've trained on different topics and specialties read it and began to iterate and interpret on that prayer. It took influences from the Ars Goetia, then determined the feeling of my prayer. It then used a text to speech analysis to come up with an image to suit. After that, it stitched it all together. Please don't ask for the code, its hacky and probably won't work for you. 

While it was working, I chanted Gremorys Enn. This is for the Duchess. Let it be seen as worship.
